import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    events = inputs["events"].copy()
    events = events.sort_values(["user_id", "event_ts", "event_id"], kind="mergesort")

    records = []

    for user_id, group in events.groupby("user_id", sort=False):
        group = group.sort_values(["event_ts", "event_id"], kind="mergesort")

        session_num = 0
        session_start = None
        prev_ts = None

        gap_limit = pd.Timedelta(minutes=20)
        cap_limit = pd.Timedelta(hours=4)

        for row in group.itertuples(index=False):
            ts = row.event_ts
            eid = row.event_id

            if session_start is None:
                session_num = 1
                session_start = ts
            else:
                gap = ts - prev_ts
                cap_exceeded = (ts - session_start) > cap_limit

                if gap > gap_limit or cap_exceeded:
                    session_num += 1
                    session_start = ts

            prev_ts = ts
            records.append((user_id, session_num, eid, ts))

    cols = ["user_id", "session_num", "event_id", "event_ts"]
    if records:
        df = pd.DataFrame(records, columns=cols)
    else:
        df = pd.DataFrame(columns=cols)
        df["user_id"] = df["user_id"].astype("int64")
        df["session_num"] = df["session_num"].astype("int64")
        df["event_id"] = df["event_id"].astype("int64")
        df["event_ts"] = pd.to_datetime(df["event_ts"])

    if len(df) == 0:
        result = pd.DataFrame(
            columns=["user_id", "session_num", "session_start", "session_end", "event_count"]
        )
        result["user_id"] = result["user_id"].astype("int64")
        result["session_num"] = result["session_num"].astype("int64")
        result["event_count"] = result["event_count"].astype("int64")
        return {"user_sessions": result}

    grouped = df.groupby(["user_id", "session_num"], sort=True)

    result = grouped.agg(
        session_start=("event_ts", "min"),
        session_end=("event_ts", "max"),
        event_count=("event_id", "count"),
    ).reset_index()

    result = result.sort_values(["user_id", "session_num"], kind="mergesort").reset_index(drop=True)

    return {"user_sessions": result}
